card.name: Just before the word common
card.fires_on: Linking or degree words (is, are, was, more, less, remarkably, far from) right before the word "common" or a similar idea like "the rule" or "the norm". It fires where the text is about how frequent something is.

modes.label: Verb before common
modes.description: A form of "to be" after a subject, with "common" expected next.
modes.example: If life<< is>> common and seems to be very similar,

modes.label: Degree word before common
modes.description: An adverb such as more, less, or remarkably that leads into "common".
modes.example: This type of hyperplasia is<< less>> common than usual hyperplasia.

modes.label: Rule or norm phrasing
modes.description: Words leading to "the rule" or "the norm", meaning widespread.
modes.example: planets around stars <<are>> the rule rather than the exception.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "common" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the words just before "common" when a text says how frequent something is.
